text: INTC's 2.13 beta and -82% max drawdown mean a $100 stake can evaporate to $18 in a single bad cycle — the 28.6% worst day in the last two years proves gap risk is real. With 36 holds and only 12 buys, the Street has zero conviction, and Nvidia's 4% stake looks more like a strategic hedge than a vote of confidence.
